title: Adjusting some state when a prop changes

slides.say: When the items prop changes, you want to clear only the selection, not all the state.
In an Effect, the list and its children first render with the stale selection, then everything renders again.
Better: store the previous items, and adjust state during render. React re-renders right away, before the children render the stale value. The condition prevents a loop.
Best of all: store the selected ID and calculate the selection. Most components should not need adjusting at all.
